Done! I've implemented all three functions:

1. **clamp(n, min, max)** in src/num.js — returns n bounded to [min, max]

3. **slugify(title)** in src/text.js — converts to lowercase, trims, replaces space runs with dashes, and strips non-alphanumeric characters except dashes
